news.headline: Free train passes for everyone over 60 from Monday, says insider. Share before it is deleted!
tells: It quotes only an unnamed "insider" and no official body.
No other news outlet you know reports it.
It urges you to share before it is "deleted", which is a pressure tactic.
Check the railway company's own website before you forward anything.

attacker_reveal: A big free gift and a reason to hurry... you did the spreading for me. Always check a second source before you forward.
